title: British Council LearnEnglish speaking practice
description: Free self-study speaking lessons organized by English level, with videos, preparation activities and exercises.
evidence_summary: The official resource provides speaking activities organized by language level. It is a learning resource, not a guarantee of a particular fluency outcome.
limitations: Self-study does not replace live conversation or individualized feedback.
Progress depends on practice, starting level and other individual circumstances.
steps: Choose a lesson appropriate for your English level.
Complete the preparation and video exercises.
Practise the useful phrases aloud and use them in a real conversation.

title: Organizing Instruction and Study to Improve Student Learning
description: A research-informed study guide covering spaced learning, practice questions and other approaches to learning and memory.
source_name: Institute of Education Sciences — What Works Clearinghouse
evidence_summary: The practice guide assigns evidence ratings to individual recommendations. These include spacing learning over time and using quizzes to retrieve information.
limitations: This is a general study guide, not a personalized timetable.
Evidence ratings differ across individual recommendations.
steps: Select one topic you need to learn.
Test your memory without looking at the notes.
Schedule another practice session after a delay.

title: National Career Service
description: Official Government of India portal for job searches, career guidance, internships, skills resources and related employment services.
source_name: National Career Service — Ministry of Labour and Employment
evidence_summary: The official portal describes its employment and career-support services and states that NCS does not charge fees for registration, job applications or interviews.
limitations: The portal does not guarantee employment.
Check eligibility and listing details before applying.
Beware of fraudulent people or websites claiming to represent NCS.
steps: Identify your target role and relevant skills.
Search the official portal for suitable vacancies or career resources.

title: Financial Awareness Messages: Budgeting, Saving and Responsible Borrowing
description: Reserve Bank of India financial-literacy material covering budgeting, savings and responsible borrowing.
evidence_summary: The RBI material explains budgeting as planning future income and expenditure and comparing actual spending with the plan.
limitations: General financial-literacy material, not personalized financial advice.
A budget cannot eliminate unexpected expenses or guarantee savings.
steps: List your income and essential expenses.
Record actual spending and compare it with your plan.
Review the budget regularly and adjust realistic spending targets.

title: Doing What Matters in Times of Stress
description: World Health Organization illustrated guide with practical self-help techniques for coping with stress.
evidence_summary: WHO describes this guide as a skills-based resource for coping with adversity, with exercises that can be used independently.
limitations: A self-help guide does not diagnose or replace professional assessment or treatment.
People who are struggling to cope should seek suitable professional or community support.
steps: Read the guide's instructions before choosing an exercise.
Try a short exercise that feels appropriate for your circumstances.
Notice whether it is useful and seek further support when needed.
